mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_photo (user_seq, milestone_seq, photo_type, storage_key, cdn_url, weight_kg, is_main, version, parent_photo_seq, taken_at) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{milestoneSeq}, #{photoType}, #{storageKey}, #{cdnUrl}, #{weightKg}, #{isMain}, #{version}, #{parentPhotoSeq}, #{takenAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_photo WHERE photo_seq = #{photoSeq} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM tb_photo WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND is_main = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY photo_type, created_at DESC
